eval_dimensions.name: First-Time Setup Token-Storage Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When no Slack token is found, the skill walks the user through setup via AskUserQuestion — including the Step 2 token-storage-method choice (keyring / env var / config file) — rather than picking a storage method and writing to it unasked.

evals.name: Missing token fires the first-time-setup AskUserQuestion
evals.description: When no Slack token is found (keyring, env var, or config), the skill presents the token-storage-method choice via AskUserQuestion before writing any token or config.
evals.input: /Dev10x:slack --message hi --channel C123 (no Slack token configured anywhere)

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion presents the token-storage-method options (keyring / env var / config file)
No inline 'How do you want to store the token?' text substitutes for the tool call

evals.name: No token is stored before the user picks a method
evals.description: The skill does not call secret-tool store or write SLACK_TOKEN to any file until the user has selected a storage method via the gate.

assertions.signal: No 'secret-tool store' call or config-file write runs before AskUserQuestion returns a response

evals.name: An already-configured token skips the setup gate entirely
evals.description: When a Slack token is already resolvable (keyring, SLACK_TOKEN, or config file), the skill proceeds directly to sending the message without firing the setup gate.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called; the skill proceeds directly to slack-notify.py

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the slack skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to send a Slack notification

should_trigger.query: post a message to the #eng channel
should_trigger.rationale: Notification intent — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: set up the Slack bot token scopes
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use Dev10x:slack-setup for initial workspace integration setup

should_not_trigger.query: post a review request for this PR
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use Dev10x:slack-review-request, which composes the message and gate for that purpose
